[Config] This now routes every experimental domain exclusively through `previewFlags`, which also removes the legacy `otel.semconv-stability.opt-in=rpc` behavior. The linked #20408 explicitly says not to change RPC selector compatibility; retain the legacy fallback for RPC while removing it for service-peer, unless the linked requirement is intentionally being expanded.

[Testing] This variant now selects preview conventions but remains named `testConnectionTelemetryEnabledStableSemconv`. Rename it with a `PreviewSemconv` suffix and update its `check` dependency and `.github/scripts/instrumentations.sh` entry.
[Testing] This unit suite now exercises preview service-peer conventions, so retaining `testStableSemconvUnitTests` is misleading and conflicts with the preview-task naming convention.

[Testing] This variant now selects preview conventions but remains named `testConnectionTelemetryEnabledStableSemconv`. Rename it with a `PreviewSemconv` suffix and update its `check` dependency and `.github/scripts/instrumentations.sh` entry.

[Testing] The version-1.7 variant now selects preview service-peer conventions but is still named `version17TestStableSemconv`. Rename it to `version17TestPreviewSemconv` and update both CI-script references and the `check` dependency.

[Testing] This controller-telemetry variant now selects preview conventions but retains the `StableSemconv` name. Rename it to `testControllerTelemetryPreviewSemconv` and update the `check` dependency and instrumentation CI entry.

[Testing] This suite now selects preview service-peer conventions but is still named `stableSemconvUnitTests`. Rename it to `previewSemconvUnitTests` and update the `check` reference so task names accurately identify the mode they exercise.
